title: How do I…?
bookingA: On Home, open a salon near you and tick the services you want. Tap Pick a time, choose a free time and tap Book now. You can have up to 2 upcoming bookings at once.
servicesQ: How do I choose services and a time?
servicesA: On the salon's page, tick one or more services: the price and the time they take show at the bottom. Tap Pick a time, choose a day, then a free time, then Continue.
codeA: Every booking gets a 4-digit code. Show it at the salon when you arrive, so they can start your booking. You'll find it on Home and on the booking's page.
payA: You pay at the salon, not in the app. A "from" price can go up at the salon, for example for long hair.
moveQ: How do I move or cancel a booking?
moveA: Open the booking in My bookings, then tap Move to another time or Cancel booking. A booking can be moved until 1 hour before it starts.
freeCancelQ: Until when can I cancel for free?
freeCancelA: Cancelling is free until 1 hour before the start, and always in the first 10 minutes after you book. After that it counts as a late cancel. The booking's page shows the exact time.
missedQ: What if I miss a booking?
missedA: A booking that isn't started within 10 minutes of its time is marked missed automatically. Show your code as soon as you arrive. Missed bookings and late cancels count: 3 within 60 days stop online booking for 30 days (you can still walk in). Marked missed by mistake? Write to us with the booking number.
earlierQ: Can I get an earlier time if one opens?
earlierA: Turn on "Tell me if an earlier time opens" when you book, or on the booking's page. If someone cancels earlier that day, we send you a message and you choose whether to move. Whoever moves first gets it.
comeBackA: Some days after a visit, we send you one message when it's time for the same service again (the salon decides how many days). Tap it to book the same services. You can switch it off in Profile.
offersA: When a salon you've been to has a discount, we send you a message. Switch them off for all salons in Profile, or for one salon on its page. Offers always show on the salon's page anyway.
placesQ: How do I save my Home or Work address?
placesA: On Home, tap Change on the location bar (or Profile, then Manage addresses), then Add an address. Save it as Home, Work or any name, and drag the pin onto your building. Salons never see your address.
nearOtherQ: How do I find salons near another place?
nearOtherA: On Home, tap Change on the location bar and pick a saved place, or add a new one. The salons near that place show. Pick Current location to go back.
ratingsQ: How do I rate a visit?
ratingsA: After your visit, open it in My bookings (Past) and choose the stars. You can change your rating for 14 days. Your comment is seen only by the salon.
notificationsQ: How do I get notifications on my phone?
notificationsA: On Android, turn on Booking notifications in Profile and tap Allow. On iPhone, first tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen", open Clozest from there and turn them on in Profile. Every message also shows under the bell on Home.
phoneEmailQ: How do I change my mobile number or email?
phoneEmailA: In Profile, tap Change next to Mobile or Email, and enter the codes we send to check it's you. Lost your old number? Verify an email first: the code then goes there.
languageQ: How do I change the language?
languageA: In Profile, tap the language button at the top, or pick one under Language. Our messages to you come in that language too.
deleteQ: How do I delete my account?
deleteA: In Profile, tap Delete my account at the bottom and enter the code we send. Your upcoming bookings are cancelled and your name, phone and email are removed. It can't be undone.
noSalonsQ: There are no salons near me. What can I do?
noSalonsA: We're adding salons area by area. Check near a saved place (like Work), or tell us your area and we'll come to you sooner.
smsCodeQ: The SMS code doesn't come. What can I do?
smsCodeA: Codes can take a minute. Check the number and that your phone has signal, then tap Send a new code after 30 seconds. Still nothing? Call us or WhatsApp us below.
emailCodeQ: The email code doesn't come. What can I do?
emailCodeA: Look in Spam and Promotions too. Tap Send again after 30 seconds, or Change the email if it was typed wrong. Still nothing? Call us or WhatsApp us from Help.
whyEmailQ: Why do I need to verify an email?
whyEmailA: It's how you get your account back if you lose your phone number, and where our written replies go. You only do it once. You can book only after it, but Call us and WhatsApp work without it.
salonProblemQ: The salon was closed, refused my booking or charged more. What can I do?
salonProblemA: Tell us with the booking number (like SB7K3Q9X): we talk to the salon about it. If a missed mark was wrong, we take it off so it doesn't count.
runningLateQ: I'm running late. What can I do?
runningLateA: Open the booking in My bookings and tap Move to another time, until 1 hour before it starts. If it's later than that, go as soon as you can: the booking waits 10 minutes after its time.
